info.name: Billboard Social Service
info.description:
Full API collection (~189 endpoints). Set `baseUrl`, `token`, and `internalApiKey` in the collection variables.

Base URLs:
- Local: http://localhost:8082
- Prod: https://apigateway.pineapps.online/social

Auth: Authorization: Bearer {{token}} for user endpoints; X-Internal-Api-Key for /internal/**.

request.description: 200. Call at least once per minute; presence expires ~60s after last heartbeat.
